title: fix(cli): os migrate plan no longer lists sys_packages as unmanaged after os migrate apply created it
body:
Fixes #24059

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`os migrate plan` no longer lists `sys_packages` under "declared by no object in this plan" after `os migrate apply` has created it. A genuinely stranded `sys_*` table is still listed.

`sys_packages` is the package registry's table. It is not an object. `PackageServicePlugin.start()` creates it with raw DDL, and since #23022 `os migrate apply` creates it from the registry's `package.storage` declaration. The plan's unmanaged-table sweep built its known set from the planned drivers' managed tables and the declared objects only. `sys_packages` is neither, so every plan after an apply reported the live registry table as if it were stranded.

- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`: `findPackageStorage(kernel)` is now the one reader of the `package.storage` declaration (the lookup and the shape check that used to open `planPackageTable`). `bootSchemaStack` reads it once per boot. `planPackageTable` plans the table from that object as before, on a deferring boot only. The same object's `table` is exposed as `SchemaStack.nonObjectTables`. It is filled on every boot, whether or not the table exists and whether or not anything is planned for it, and it is `[]` when the boot composed no package registry.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts`: `buildKnownTableNames(managed, declaredObjects, nonObjectTables)` adds those names verbatim. `collectUnmanagedTables` takes a required `nonObjectTables` option and passes it through. The module header's list of legitimate platform-prefixed families gains this one as item 4. No table name is spelled in the sweep.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/plan.ts`: passes `stack.nonObjectTables` to the sweep. The sweep reads the declaration from the same boot and kernel the plan runs in.

## Measured before changing anything (PM hypotheses)

- **H1, confirmed** at `aa31569b2`: `buildKnownTableNames` returned the managed set plus each declared object's `name` and resolved table name, and `selectUnmanagedTables` reported every platform-prefixed table outside it.
- **H2, confirmed**: `planPackageTable` returns `null` when the table is present. Door reading below: after the apply, the plan's `pending` is `[]`, so the planned work names nothing. The fix therefore reads the declaration, not the planned work. The sweep runs in the same boot as the plan: `bootSchemaStack` reads the declaration from the kernel it booted, and `plan.ts` hands it to the sweep from the returned stack.
- **H3, pinned as a decision**: when no package registry is composed, `nonObjectTables` is `[]`, and a `sys_packages` table left in that database is still reported. Through the door this case does not arise on a mirrored boot. The sweep runs only when the composition mirrors the served boot, and that composition always mounts `PackageServicePlugin` through the always-on `package-registry` slate (`composeServedPlatform` in `schema-migration-plugins.ts`, and the base reading's composition note lists it). So the decision is pinned at unit level ("DECISION: a boot that composed no package registry …").
- **H4, re-measured at base `aa31569b2`** on `examples/app-crm`. Setup: a fresh sqlite file with `sys_legacy_widget` created up front, fresh `OS_HOME`, DB env unset, run through `packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js` with `--database-url file:DB`. Then `migrate apply --yes`, then `migrate plan`, then `migrate plan --json`:
  - base: apply printed `+ sys_packages [create_table, 7 column(s)]` and `Created/extended 80 table(s)`. The plan printed `2 table(s) … declared by no object in this plan:` with `• sys_legacy_widget` and `• sys_packages`. `--json`: `unmanagedTables.tables` = `sys_legacy_widget`, `sys_packages`, `physicalTables` 81, `pending` `[]`.
  - head `04c0d95ec`: same apply. The plan printed `1 table(s) …:` with `• sys_legacy_widget` only. `--json`: `tables` = `sys_legacy_widget`, `physicalTables` 81, `pending` `[]`. Both tables are physically present after each run.

## Pins

- `unmanaged-tables.test.ts`, new describe `[#24059] a table the composition declares outside the object set`. It has three cases: the known set holds the name only when it is declared; after an apply the registry table is not reported and `sys_legacy_widget` still is; and the H3 decision. Every existing `buildKnownTableNames` / `collectUnmanagedTables` call states `nonObjectTables` explicitly.
- `unmanaged-tables.integration.test.ts` uses a real boot with the composition `plan` uses. `sys_packages` joins the negative controls, and the premise case asserts that `stack.nonObjectTables` equals the `table` of the kernel's own `package.storage` service while nothing is pending for it.
- `schema-migrate.package-table.integration.test.ts`: `nonObjectTables` is `['sys_packages']` on the plan of a never-started project and on the plan after the apply, when `pending` holds nothing for the table.
- Two door-level pins encoded the defect, and they flip with this change. `plan.boot-parity.integration.test.ts` expected the sweep to name exactly `sys_packages`, and now expects it to name nothing. `plan.telemetry-sibling.integration.test.ts` expected `sys_packages` plus the sibling's retired table, and now expects only the retired table. Both pins were green at base with the old expectation, so the new one fails against the old sweep. The H4 base reading shows the same thing.

## Ablation (fix committed first, at `04c0d95ec`)

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts --anchor 'for (const table of nonObjectTables) known.add(table);' --delete -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/unmanaged-tables.test.ts`, under the verify lock:

- the anchor went 1 to 0, and the blob went `99e653e8d5d0` to `33c383315c85`;
- `Tests 2 failed | 43 passed (45)`. The two red cases are the "known set" case and the "after an apply" case. The DECISION case stayed green, as expected, because it asserts the direction without a declaration;
- restore: the blob equals HEAD (`99e653e8d5d0`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

The unit suite imports `./unmanaged-tables.js` relatively, so it reads `src/` and no `dist/` rebuild applies.

## Tests and gates

All readings are at head `7a3803bd3` unless another commit is named. `04c0d95ec` is the fix commit. `7a3803bd3` merges `origin/main` `b9ac35cbf`, which touches CI workflows and only one file in `packages/cli`: `test/published-entry-node-env-source-reroute.test.ts`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` at `04c0d95ec`: exit 0. That is `tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck`, which held 3 files, 28 errors and 6 signatures. `tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --listFilesOnly` puts all 5 touched test files in its 1611-file program.
- Unit tier at `04c0d95ec`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 2 failed | 308 passed (310)`, `Tests 4573 passed | 29 skipped`. The two files, `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` and `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`, were refused before their bodies ran ("packages/cli is not built"). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, both pass: `Tests 29 passed (29)`.
- Integration tier at `04c0d95ec`, the four touched files with `--project integration`: `unmanaged-tables.integration` and `schema-migrate.package-table.integration` 4 passed, `plan.boot-parity.integration` 3 passed, `plan.telemetry-sibling.integration` 2 passed.
- After the merge: `test/published-entry-node-env-source-reroute.test.ts` and `src/utils/unmanaged-tables.test.ts`, 50 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7a3803bd3`: 64 commands, merge base `b9ac35cbf`, 9 paths, 232 changed lines. All 64 ran, with each exit code captured before any pipe. 62 exited 0 on the first run. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET); both exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2` (76 tasks, 75 cached). `--ran`: `64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 8 changed `.ts` files: exit 0. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **One more refusal path, stated.** `findPackageStorage` now runs on every boot, not only a deferring one. A `package.storage` service of the wrong shape (a version skew between `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/service-package`) now also fails the skip-schema-sync boot of `plan`, `apply` and `organization-ownership` (the Turso remote transport). It fails with the release-mismatch error those commands already gave on every deferring boot. Only those three commands, plus `unmapped-columns`, compose the registry. The changeset says so.
- The section's sentence still reads "declared by no object in this plan". The rows it lists are still declared by nothing, so the wording is unchanged.
- `nonObjectTables` is a union across every planned database, like the managed set beside it. The registry writes to the default driver, so a `sys_packages` table in the `telemetry` sibling would also go unreported. Over-excluding is the module's stated safe direction. Not measured; no carrier.
